basis: Owner direction: eliminate automatic cross-model-review bypasses; all consequential components accountable through exact evidence and independent critique. Offline candidate fixes for wrong-task/final-revision, stale owner application, complete public verification, planner independence and quorum/deferral bypasses are in progress in isolated checkouts. Actual cross-model review and promotion remain pending; internal Codex subagents do not count. Broader routing/coordination qualification, specialist dispatch bridge and continuing empirical controls remain open. docs/reviews/2026-11-16-workflow-handoffs/ records requirements and evidence.
